statement: The staged list is a superset of the candidates staged: a stage lists its document and window, one member added unconditionally so concurrent stages of other documents never make it fail, before it writes its candidate, and a listing that fails fails the stage with nothing written; a candidate is withdrawn before its window is unlisted, and a withdrawal that fails leaves it listed. Every shadow pass, under its lease, keeps the list, lists the window of a shadowing change whose candidate is written and not listed, and unlists a window whose document stages no candidate of it once two passes in a row found it so.
